This bean plot is only 0.24 hectares, so buying fertilizer or new seed would cost too much cash for the little I will harvest here. I will carry manure from my goats and spread it before planting, and I will use the bean seed I kept from last season since I know it grows well on this land. My family will do all the work — planting, weeding three times, and harvesting — which I expect will take us about 20 days in total. I will not buy chemicals, hire workers, or irrigate because I have no pump and the rains should come in November like they always do.
